title: Pending Estimate Months: Days Before a Skilled Admission or After a Discharge Elsewhere
content:
**Rule (Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage).** Days of a pending estimate month outside the stay: where the resident's Medicare coverage with the latest coverage start date began inside the month on the day its qualifying hospital stay ended, a skilled admission, and the resident's bed-hold reservation that ended because the hospital discharged the resident elsewhere, the one with the latest end date, had its last held day inside the month, the days of the month before that admission and the days after that last held day are both taken out; where only that admission fell inside the month, the days of the month before it; where only that last held day fell inside the month, the days of the month after it; otherwise none.

The coverage is the resident's Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage with the latest coverage start date; the reservation is under Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations. Days taken out carry no cost.

| Skilled admission inside the month (latest coverage start inside the month, on the day its qualifying hospital stay ended) | Last held day of the latest reservation ended by a discharge elsewhere, inside the month | Days taken out |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | the days before the admission and the days after the last held day |
| yes | no | the days before the admission |
| no | yes | the days after the last held day |
| no | no | none |

*Hypothetical:* a 30-day month with a skilled admission on day 14 (days 1 to 13 taken out) and a discharge-elsewhere reservation whose last held day is day 28 (days 29 and 30 taken out) — 15 days in all. A latest coverage start on day 14 following a hospital stay that ended on day 12 is not a skilled admission for this rule.
